audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].side said 'Akali' while win[5] said 'Aurelion Sol', and phases[6].side said 'Skill' while win[6] said 'Aurelion Sol' — the page rendered two different answers for the same two rows. The packet also flags the chart as contradicting a 53.84% win rate over 847 games.
audit.why: The two layers are the same row and must agree; the first-item and two-item rows are where Aurelion Sol's scaling actually takes over, which is what the win rate reflects.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side flipped to 'Aurelion Sol' to match win[5]/win[6], which already held the correct value. Levels 1-6 left with Akali: her Shroud/Flip pattern genuinely owns that window and inventing a shift there would mislead.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] attributed the level 6 spike to Shuriken Flip (a level 3 ability) instead of Perfect Execution, and spikes[2]/spikes[3] credited a 'W stun', 'full Comet damage', '5-star burst' and 'global presence'.
audit.why: Aurelion Sol's stun is Falling Star (R, 120/110/100s); Astral Flight (W) has no CC; he has no global ability; Comet is a rune. Akali's R is Perfect Execution, 120/90/60s, with an executing recast.
audit.corrected: Spikes rekeyed to Perfect Execution at 6, Rod of Ages plus Falling Star at first item, and The Skies Descend late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent everywhere: Perfect Execution's second cast is a threshold execute, and her combo opens with an Assassin's Mark empowered auto-attack reset.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions rules 'execute-threshold' and 'autoreset-burst-tell'; enemyKit R flag execute, P flag autoReset.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] now names the threshold; early now names the empowered-auto wind-up as the step-back cue; dosFull[1] now tells you to save Flash and the stun for the executing recast rather than the leap.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers and a name-swappable 'fifth summoner spell' line.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud 20s at rank 1, Astral Flight 22s at rank 1, Falling Star 120s are the three clocks this lane runs on.

audit.whatIsWrong: early referenced a 'shield shard' Aurelion Sol does not have; mid and late referenced 'flashing Comet' and a 'global ultimate'.
audit.why: ownerKit has no shield and no global flag on any slot.
audit.corrected: Replaced with Falling Star, the held beam and The Skies Descend.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.carry and enemyWin were all name-swappable templates.
audit.why: Each sentence would read identically with any other enemy substituted.
audit.corrected: Grounded in Perfect Execution's two casts, Shroud's 20s clear window, and the beam channel being cancellable.

edits.before: Akali wins by landing Twilight Shroud, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Akali wins by opening from inside Twilight Shroud, cancelling your beam channel, and finishing with the Perfect Execution recast.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside — hold your CC and burst for when she exits. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Astral Flight like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Akali Twilight Shroud: 20s at rank 1 — she is untargetable inside it, so hold the beam and the stun for the moment she steps out. - Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1: your escape, never your poke. - Falling Star: 120s, kill windows only.

edits.before: Carry by scaling honestly — every stardust stack is permanent, and the 30-minute version of you wins fights your laning self cannot imagine.
edits.after: Carry by making her spend Shroud on nothing: it is 20s, and every stardust stack you bank while she waits on it is permanent damage.

edits.before: W-flyby: fly a lateral arc, drag Q across Akali for two seconds of burn + stacks, and land outside his answer range — repeat forever from one item.
edits.after: Perfect Execution is a two-part dash: the leap comes first, so save Flash and the Falling Star stun for the recast that actually executes you.

edits.before: Channelling Q face-to-face inside his engage range with W down — every champion that touches you wins that exchange pre-items.
edits.after: Her Shroud shove out-clears you pre-item, and contesting it puts you in Shuriken Flip range with Astral Flight still on its 22 seconds.

edits.before: Your first core item's stun-into-burst finally threatens her for engaging without full HP
edits.after: Rod of Ages plus a held Falling Star finally punishes her for engaging without full HP

edits.before: Two-item global ultimate and zone control outpace her assassin kit once teamfights start
edits.after: Two items of stardust scaling and black-hole zoning outpace her assassin kit in teamfights

edits.before: Twilight Shroud lets Akali dive your zone invisible, land Q-E combos, and vanish before your slow Comet ever tracks her.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud makes her untargetable inside it, so she lands the Q-E combo and vanishes before your beam can finish a tick.

edits.before: Shuriken Flip lets her re-engage or escape through your ult zone entirely, making her all-in threat nearly unanswerable pre-item.
edits.after: Perfect Execution at 6 dashes twice and executes on the recast — track the threshold HP, not the bar, and Shuriken Flip covers her exit.

edits.before: Once you have a completed item, your W stun into full Comet damage punishes her for entering Shroud range without full HP.
edits.after: Once Rod of Ages lands, Falling Star's stun into a held beam punishes her for entering your range at anything under full HP.

edits.before: Your global presence and 5-star burst let you zone Shroud engages from max range, something Akali's melee assassin kit can't punish anymore.
edits.after: Stacked stardust and The Skies Descend let you zone her engage from 1250 range, something Akali's melee assassin kit can no longer punish.

edits.before: Akali's Twilight Shroud lets her vanish, close the gap invisibly, and detonate Q mark plus E for a burst combo your early kit has no answer to — you can't out-range someone who disappears. Every trade she initiates from inside Shroud is close to unavoidable before you have the HP or shield shard to survive it. Play maximum range, never extend past minions, and treat any dimmed vision near your lane as a dive in progress.
edits.after: Akali's Twilight Shroud lets her vanish, close the gap invisibly, and detonate her mark plus E for a burst combo your early kit has no answer to — you can't out-range someone who disappears. Her opener is an Assassin's Mark empowered auto, so the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the ability cast itself. Play maximum range, never extend past minions, and treat any dimmed vision near your lane as a dive in progress.

edits.before: Shuriken Flip gives her a dash in and a dash out, so even flashing Comet onto her doesn't guarantee a kill — she can flip away mid-animation. You're still surviving off pathing discipline rather than winning trades here; a jungler-assisted gank is your best realistic kill window since she has to commit Shroud to engage. Ward the river entrances to her Shroud angles and don't push the wave into her all-in range around level 6.
edits.after: Shuriken Flip is 16s at rank 1 and gives her a dash in and a dash out, so even landing Falling Star does not guarantee a kill. You're still surviving off pathing discipline rather than winning trades here; a jungler-assisted gank is your best realistic kill window since she has to commit Shroud to engage. Ward the river entrances to her Shroud angles and don't push the wave into her all-in range around level 6.

edits.before: Once you finish your first item your W stun finally lands reliably enough to lock her down before she can escape through Shroud, and your Comet burst punishes any dive that isn't at full resources. By two items your global ultimate threat forces her to babysit mid instead of roaming, flipping the map-pressure dynamic in your favor. Hold max range, bait her Shroud engage, then punish the cooldown window hard.
edits.after: Once Rod of Ages lands, Falling Star finally locks her down before she can slip back into Twilight Shroud, and a held beam punishes any dive she starts under full resources. By two items The Skies Descend forces her to babysit mid instead of roaming, flipping the map-pressure dynamic in your favor. Hold max range, bait the 20-second Shroud, then punish that window hard.
